messages:
maria: quick heads-up — I'm proposing a tiny UX change: add a per-route 'prefetch_sampling' toggle in the Console so we don't prefetch request bodies into the logging pipeline for sensitive routes. link: https://go/redwood/prefetch-sampler-proto :thinking:
kevin: can you sketch the failure modes? e.g. risk of under-sampling important errors if prefetch is off?
ash: @maria curious if this is just a boolean or needs levels (off/minimal/full). also how does this interact with sticky sampling?
maria: good Qs. plan: boolean default ON for existing routes, OFF for routes tagged with sensitivity. sticky sampling still applies — toggle prevents prefetching request/response payloads into the ingest path, but metadata + headers still sampled.
ben: will we surface the effective sampling rate in the UI? ops need to know how many requests are being dropped from payload capture. otherwise customers will complain about missing traces.
maria: yes — plan is a dashboard card + route-level line chart showing: sampling_rate, prefetch_enabled (bool), payload_capture_rate. telemetry-bot: metrics created: sampler.prefetch.enabled{route}, sampler.prefetch.payload_captured{route}, sampler.prefetch.effective_rate{route} — emitting now to staging.
kevin: from infra side, what's the perf impact of toggling? if we partially disable prefetch, does it reduce CPU/IO on shipper?
ben: initial numbers from staging show ~15% reduction in shipper CPU when prefetch off for chatty routes. small win for cost.
sre-oncall: rollback story? if console toggle causes missing data for an active incident we need a quick 'force-prefetch' breakglass. can we add a temporal override API?
maria: yes — propose an admin breakglass API: POST /internal/v1/prefetch/override {route, ttl_seconds, reason}. auditable by SSO. UI will show active overrides.
nash: UX nit — please keep toggle out of the general route edit flow; put it under "Privacy & Telemetry" to avoid accidental flips.
kevin: config example for the backend; agree with separation.

```
# example route config snippet
route: "/v1/chat"
telemetry:
  prefetch_sampling: false
  sticky_sampling: true
  override_ttl: 0
```

maria: thanks. final asks: (1) eng-platform to wire UI + API (2) eng-infra to ensure shipper respects toggle at ingestion time (3) telemetry to add dashboard + alert if payload_capture_rate drops >50% for a route.
ben: will draft the dashboard panels and add a small alert rule.
sre-oncall: add runbook note: if true-positive errors stop reproducing after toggle, escalate to Incident Response.
kevin: I'm going to schedule a canary rollout for the API AND a console flag rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy to staging at 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z. :rocket:
maria: awesome — I'll put the proposal in the docs folder and tag PMs. thanks all :thumbsup:
